<div class="wp-block-cover is-style-fb-scrim fb-hero fb-hero--medium">
<img fetchpriority="high" sizes="(max-width: 600px) 340px, (max-width: 1024px) 768px, 100vw" width="700" height="481" src="https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/stay-solymar.jpg" class="wp-block-cover__image-background attachment-full size-full" alt="" decoding="async" srcset="https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/stay-solymar.jpg 700w, https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/stay-solymar-300x206.jpg 300w" />		<span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-100 has-background-dim"></span>
<div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container">
<p class="fb-crumb"><a href="https://www.flagbeach.com/">Home</a> / <a href="https://www.flagbeach.com/accommodation/">Stays</a></p>						<h1>Sol y Mar surf camp</h1>
<p class="fb-lead">The Flag Beach surf hostel Sol y Mar is the original hostel regarded as the best value surf hostel in Fuerteventura, a great place for single travelers or groups of surfers.</p>		</div>
</div>
<section class="wp-block-group fb-section is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group fb-wrap is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow"><div class="fb-facts"><div class="fb-fact"><span class="fb-fact__l">Type</span><span class="fb-fact__v">Hostel</span></div><div class="fb-fact"><span class="fb-fact__l">To Flag Beach</span><span class="fb-fact__v">4 km</span></div><div class="fb-fact"><span class="fb-fact__l">Min. stay</span><span class="fb-fact__v">3 nights</span></div></div>
<div class="wp-block-group fb-single is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow" style="margin-top:32px">
<div class="wp-block-group fb-single__main is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow"><div class="entry-content fb-prose wp-block-post-content is-layout-flow wp-block-post-content-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our surf hostel Sol y Mar is regarded as the best value surf hostel in Fuerteventura. It is a great place for single travelers since it has a good sociable, relaxed atmosphere, common area, 2 kitchens and a roof top for BBQs and sunbathing. It is located in the Old Town of Corralejo, just 3 minutes walk from the best bars in town! Sol Y Mar has 10 bedrooms, 2 kitchens, 4 bathrooms and a living room.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Continental breakfast is provided, but there are self catering facilities as well as a BBQ terrace on the roof. We have single, twin, double, triple or quad rooms available depending on your party size. But don’t worry, no bunk beds!</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Towels and bed linen are included in the price, and the hostel is cleaned 7 days a week. The dorm has just 4 beds in a large room.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We are flexible on arrival days but require a minimum stay of 3 nights. If you arrive in town and can’t find us give us a call and we’ll pick you up. If you want to get around the town you can also arrange bike hire at a local shop.</p>
</div>
</div>
<aside class="fb-panel" data-fb-panel>
<p class="fb-eyebrow">Per night</p>
<p class="fb-panel__price">On request</p>
<p class="fb-panel__desc">Prices for this are being finalised. Ask us and we will tell you what is available for your dates.</p>
<a class="fb-btn fb-btn--primary" href="https://www.flagbeach.com/contact-us/?fb_pkg=82#contact-form">Send us your dates <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
<ul class="fb-rows">
<li><a href="https://www.flagbeach.com/packages/"><span>Pair it with a course or camp</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p class="fb-panel__note">Minimum stay 3 nights.</p>
<p class="fb-panel__note">Send us your dates through the form. We confirm by email and ask for a small deposit.</p>
</aside>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<p class="fb-eyebrow wp-block-paragraph">Hours</p>
<p class="fb-mono wp-block-paragraph">Office · Mon–Sat 08:30–17:30<br>Beach · Apr–Sep 10:00–19:00<br>Beach · Oct–Mar 10:00–17:00</p>
</div>
